description: Retrieve the verified on-site result from a human task: pass/fail verdict, score and feedback, signed photo URLs, structured answers, and evidence provenance including GPS distance, capture time, and server checks. Also returns share_url: a read-only result page (valid 30 days, no login) you can send to the person who asked for the check.
name: errand_get_result
